thread:
mia: Quick brainstorm: customers keep asking for a minimal observability surface for Console. They want 1) ready-made dashboard tiles, 2) cheap tracing hooks we can turn on per-route, 3) per-route cost breakdown, 4) an error grouping view with sample requests.
devin: Yep. Suggest we name the project 'Console Lite Observability' (internal only). Focus on fast value: templates + cost table + basic error grouping.
sam: From infra side: cheap tracing = single small span on request entry/exit with attributes: route, model, token_count, status. Default sampling 0.5%? adjustable per-org.
rachel: UX priorities: small set of tile templates (cost, p50/p95 latency, error rate), filter by org/route/model, pin favorite views, export CSV. Keep interactions snappy.
mia: Proposed acceptance criteria (MVP):
- 3 templates available out of box (cost / latency / error-rate)
- Cost table: rows per-route, columns: token_in, token_out, estimated $ (per-model granularity), CSV export, and sorting
- Tracing flag: SDK option `console.obs_minimal=true` that emits a tiny span with route/model/error_code; sampling slider 0-10% in UI
- Error grouping: top 20 groups with example sanitized requests (no raw user text), ability to copy sample with redaction notice
devin: Implementation notes: routing of the minimal span should piggyback on our existing trace context. For Dedicated/Private we should default off but allow tenancy-level override. Need quotas for sample retrieval.
sam: Telemetry change: metrics pipeline needs a per-route tag; add model_id + token_in/out + gpu_ms to the event. This is additive and should be batched.
rachel: UX detail: sampling slider UI should show estimated weekly sample count and a small warning about compliance when >1%. Also add an enterprise toggle to lock sampling.
obs-bot: Created GH checklist: `gh:obs/console-lite/checklist` with items: dashboard-templates, cost-endpoint, trace-flag, sample-redaction, csv-export, sales-demo.
mia: Risk log: 1) sample exports may leak PII if redaction fails; must include auto-redact + audit event. 2) heavy sampling can increase CPU on control plane; add auto-disable threshold.
devin: Timeline: 2 sprints for dashboards + cost table + CSV export (beta), 2 more sprints for trace flag + error grouping + redaction. Beta with 2 customers in sprint 3.
sam: Blockers: infra slot for per-route metrics ingestion. I'll file infra ticket and tag SRE.
rachel: Product asks: create a quick sales demo flow and a 1-pager on sampling controls. Sales wants to show cost table + pinning + export.
mia: OK next steps: devin to write tech sketch + infra estimate by Thu EOD, rachel to produce mock tiles and copy for CSV + sampling slider, sam to open infra ticket. I'll draft PRD and share early next week. :eyes:
